# TechNext — full reference

## Questions and answers

### What is the BIR e-invoicing deadline?

Covered taxpayers must issue compliant electronic invoices on or before 31 December 2026. RR 26-2025 set the date and RMC 98-2026 kept it.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-e-invoicing-odoo

### Are micro taxpayers covered?

No. The BIR's guidelines exempt micro taxpayers from the mandatory e-invoicing requirement.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-e-invoicing-odoo

### Is my CAS permit enough to issue e-invoices?

No. You need a Permit to Issue (PTI) Electronic Invoice first. A CAS Acknowledgment Certificate or Permit to Use is not enough. EIS Certification then follows within six months of the PTI.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-e-invoicing-odoo

### Does Odoo handle BIR e-invoicing out of the box?

Odoo's Philippine localisation covers taxes, withholding and BIR reports such as 2550Q, SLSP, SAWT, QAP and a 2307 export. Its documentation does not mention EIS, so TechNext builds and tests the e-invoicing link as part of your project.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-e-invoicing-odoo

### Can TechNext help us before the deadline?

Yes. Our team in Taguig City confirms your group with your accountant, sets up Odoo for the BIR, tests the e-invoicing flow, and stays on after go-live.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-e-invoicing-odoo

### What is the difference between RAG and fine-tuning?

Fine-tuning changes the model itself by training it on examples, which suits style and format. RAG leaves the model alone and gives it the right documents at question time, which suits facts that change. For company knowledge, RAG is usually the first choice because updates only need a re-index and answers can cite sources.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/enterprise-rag-guide

### Does RAG stop AI from making things up?

It reduces it a lot but does not remove it. Strict instructions to answer only from sources, required citations, permission to say "I don't know" and regular testing against a fixed question set keep it in check.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/enterprise-rag-guide

### What documents can an enterprise RAG system use?

Most text-based content: PDFs, Word files, spreadsheets, wiki pages, helpdesk articles and email archives. Scanned documents need OCR first, and tables need careful parsing to stay readable.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/enterprise-rag-guide

### Can users see documents they are not allowed to open?

They should not. A well-built system carries each document's access rights into the index and filters results by the signed-in user before anything reaches the model.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/enterprise-rag-guide

### How long does an enterprise RAG implementation take?

It depends mostly on the state of your sources and the number of systems to connect. Starting with one use case and a pilot group gets a working assistant in front of real users sooner, and the rest is added in phases.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/enterprise-rag-guide

### How long does an Odoo implementation take?

It depends on the scope: the number of apps, companies, integrations and how clean your data is. TechNext agrees the timeline in the written scope at the end of discovery, and keeps the first phase focused so it goes live sooner.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/how-an-odoo-implementation-works

### Can we start with just one Odoo app?

Yes. Odoo is modular, and Odoo's One App Free plan covers one app for unlimited users. Most TechNext projects start with Accounting, Sales and Inventory together, because that is where money and stock move.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/how-an-odoo-implementation-works

### What does TechNext need from us to start?

A short description of how your process runs today, a decision-maker for scope questions, and later the people who run sales, stock and finance for discovery and training.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/how-an-odoo-implementation-works

### Is InvoiceNow mandatory for GST-registered businesses?

Yes. IRAS requires all GST-registered businesses to submit invoice data using InvoiceNow-Ready Solutions, rolled out in phases between 1 November 2025 and 1 April 2031.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/invoicenow-singapore-gst-timeline

### When must an existing GST-registered business comply?

It depends on total annual supplies in 2025: S$200,000 or less from 1 April 2028, S$1 million or less from 1 April 2029, S$4 million or less from 1 April 2030, and above S$4 million from 1 April 2031.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/invoicenow-singapore-gst-timeline

### Which businesses are exempt from the GST InvoiceNow Requirement?

Overseas entities, including overseas vendors under the OVR pay-only and full regimes, and businesses liable to register for GST wholly because of the reverse charge regime.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/invoicenow-singapore-gst-timeline

### Can TechNext help us get Odoo ready for InvoiceNow?

Yes. TechNext works out your implementation date, confirms how your Odoo database will send invoice data through an accredited access point, and tests it before your date.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/invoicenow-singapore-gst-timeline

### Does Odoo 20 support InvoiceNow in Singapore?

The Odoo 20 release notes say Singapore GST taxes were refined to prepare for future GST InvoiceNow document compliance. They describe groundwork, so confirm the transmission path for your database with your Odoo partner before your InvoiceNow date.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-singapore-philippines-vietnam

### Can Odoo generate BIR Form 2307?

Yes. Odoo 20 adds report variants that produce official BIR 2306 and BIR 2307 withholding tax certificates as PDFs, generated from vendor bills and optionally sent to the vendor when a bill is paid.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-singapore-philippines-vietnam

### Does Odoo 20 follow Circular 99 in Vietnam?

Yes. The Vietnamese chart of accounts and balance sheet follow Circular 99/2025/TT-BTC, and the S03a-DN general journal and S03b-DN general ledger reports comply with it.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-singapore-philippines-vietnam

### Does Odoo 20 include Philippine payroll?

Odoo 20 adds a basic Philippine payroll package with basic pay, benefits, taxes and overtime, plus BIR Forms 1601-C, 2316 and 1604-C and automatic SSS and Pag-IBIG loan deductions.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-singapore-philippines-vietnam

### How do I upgrade from Odoo 19 to Odoo 20?

Request an upgraded test database first: through the database manager on Odoo Online, through a staging branch on Odoo.sh, or with Odoo's upgrade script on-premise. Upgrade any custom modules, test thoroughly, then plan the production upgrade.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-upgrade-checklist

### Can I undo an Odoo 20 upgrade?

No. Odoo's documentation says that once the production upgrade is complete, you cannot revert to the previous version. That is why all testing happens on a copy first.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-upgrade-checklist

### Will my custom modules work in Odoo 20?

Not automatically. Custom modules must be ported to Odoo 20 before the database can be upgraded. Odoo's upgrade service covers standard apps and Studio customisations, but not custom code unless it is under a maintenance contract.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-upgrade-checklist

### Will the test database send emails to my customers?

No. In the upgraded test database, Odoo disables outgoing mail servers and scheduled actions, puts payment providers and delivery carriers in test mode, and turns off bank synchronisation.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-upgrade-checklist

### Can TechNext run our Odoo 20 upgrade?

Yes. TechNext upgrades a copy of your database first, tests your custom modules and a month-end close, then schedules the live upgrade and supports you afterwards through TechNext Care.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-upgrade-checklist

### What is in the Odoo 20 release notes?

The headline items are AI agents that automated actions can call, an MCP connector for outside AI tools, offline mode, bill payments and an Accounting Assistant. Field Service moves into Planning, payroll work entries are removed and account groups become parent accounts. Odoo publishes the full notes at odoo.com/odoo-20-release-notes.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-whats-new

### How do I upgrade to Odoo 20?

Odoo Online databases use Odoo's own upgrade service. Odoo.sh and on-premise databases, especially with custom modules, need a planned upgrade: check removed or moved features, test custom modules and Studio changes, budget AI credits, and do a dry run on a copy of the database before the live upgrade.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-whats-new

### When was Odoo 20 released?

Odoo unveiled Odoo 20 at Odoo Experience 2026 at Brussels Expo, and published the release notes in September 2026.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-whats-new

### Do Odoo 20's AI features cost extra?

Yes. Odoo's release notes say every AI feature now uses paid IAP credits, which are billed on top of the Odoo subscription.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-whats-new

### Is the Field Service app gone in Odoo 20?

The standalone Field Service app is discontinued. Its features, including the live map, routing, travel fees and worksheets, now sit in the Planning app.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-whats-new

### Can TechNext upgrade our database to Odoo 20?

Yes. TechNext upgrades a copy of your database first, tests custom modules and a month-end close, and only then schedules the live upgrade.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-20-whats-new

### Can we install custom modules on Odoo Online?

No. Odoo Online supports configuration and, on the Custom plan, Odoo Studio. Custom Python modules need Odoo.sh or an on-premise installation.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-online-vs-odoo-sh-vs-on-premise

### Which Odoo hosting option is cheapest?

Usually Odoo Online, because hosting is included in the subscription. Odoo.sh adds hosting fees on top of the Custom plan, and on-premise adds your own infrastructure and operations costs.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-online-vs-odoo-sh-vs-on-premise

### Can we move from Odoo Online to Odoo.sh later?

Yes. A database can move from Odoo Online to Odoo.sh or on-premise when you need custom code. TechNext plans and tests the move on a copy before switching.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-online-vs-odoo-sh-vs-on-premise

### Which hosting does TechNext recommend?

Odoo Online for most first phases, Odoo.sh when a requirement needs custom code, and on-premise only when IT policy or data rules require it.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/odoo-online-vs-odoo-sh-vs-on-premise

### When should a small business move from spreadsheets to an ERP?

When the spreadsheets create more work than they save: data typed twice, stock you can't trust, slow month-ends, or reports that depend on one person. The trigger is friction, not company size.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/signs-you-have-outgrown-spreadsheets

### Do we have to replace everything at once?

No. With a modular ERP such as Odoo you can start with the apps where money and stock move, usually Accounting, Sales and Inventory, and add others later on the same database.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/signs-you-have-outgrown-spreadsheets

### Can our existing spreadsheet data be imported?

Yes. Customers, vendors, products and opening balances can be imported. TechNext cleans and loads them on a staging database and reconciles balances before go-live.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/signs-you-have-outgrown-spreadsheets

### What is the difference between Odoo configuration and customisation?

Configuration uses the settings and options Odoo already has, such as taxes, workflows and approval rules. Customisation changes the software itself, either with Odoo Studio (no code) or with custom Python modules.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/standard-first-odoo-customisation

### Do customisations make Odoo upgrades harder?

Yes. Odoo releases a major version every year, and custom modules must be ported and retested for each one. Studio changes need checking too. The fewer customisations, the easier each upgrade.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/standard-first-odoo-customisation

### Does TechNext build custom Odoo modules?

Yes, when a requirement justifies it. TechNext builds custom modules on staging, keeps them in version control and includes them in upgrade testing, after checking that configuration or Studio can't do the job.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/standard-first-odoo-customisation

### What does ERP stand for?

Enterprise resource planning: software that runs a company's core processes, such as sales, inventory, purchasing and accounting, on one shared database.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/what-is-erp

### Is ERP only for large companies?

No. Modular ERPs such as Odoo let a small company start with a few apps and add more as it grows. The trigger is friction between tools, not headcount.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/what-is-erp

### What is the difference between ERP and CRM?

A CRM manages leads and customer relationships. An ERP covers the whole operation, and usually includes a CRM, so a won deal becomes an order, a delivery and an invoice in the same system.

Source: https://technext.asia/blog/what-is-erp

### Will it post to the ledger on its own?

No. The AI prepares — it reads and matches bills, drafts entries and suggests actions — but a person approves anything that posts, sends money or contacts a customer.

Source: https://technext.asia/odoo/vietnam

### Does Odoo follow Circular 99 in Vietnam?

Yes. In Odoo 20, the Vietnamese chart of accounts and balance sheet follow Circular 99/2025/TT-BTC, and the S03a-DN general journal and S03b-DN general ledger comply with it. Circular 99 replaces Circular 200 for financial years starting on or after 1 January 2026.

Source: https://technext.asia/odoo/vietnam

### Can Odoo issue e-invoices in Vietnam?

Yes. Odoo sends invoices to SInvoice, Viettel's e-invoice platform, including replacement and adjustment invoices. In Odoo 20, Point of Sale can also issue SInvoice e-invoices for POS orders.

Source: https://technext.asia/odoo/vietnam

### Which decree governs e-invoices in Vietnam now?

Decree 254/2026/ND-CP, in force since 1 July 2026 with Circular 91/2026/TT-BTC. It replaces Decree 123/2020/ND-CP as amended by Decree 70/2025/ND-CP. Odoo's documentation does not mention the new decree yet, so we check your invoice setup against it during discovery.

Source: https://technext.asia/odoo/vietnam

### Is VAT in Vietnam still 8%?

For many goods and services, yes, until 31 December 2026. Resolution 204/2025/QH15 cut the 10% rate to 8% from 1 July 2025, with some sectors left out, such as telecoms, banking, insurance and real estate. We set the rate per product with your accountant.

Source: https://technext.asia/odoo/vietnam

### Can Odoo export the 01/GTGT VAT declaration?

Yes. Odoo 20 adds the Tax Declaration Form 01/GTGT and its Appendix 142, and exports both as XML for import into HTKK.

Source: https://technext.asia/odoo/vietnam
